banner.title: THE MM2 AQUATIC ENCOUNTER TABLES WALK - THE 12 SURFACE AND DEPTHS GRIDS (print p. 137: the 6 main areas cold, temperate and tropical, each freshwater and saltwater, each surface and depths; the 13 hazard rows, the 4 pointer rows, the 3 lung dragon cross-refs), the AQUATIC-FLIP round - the Aquatic Random Encounter Tables gap box flips to closed
banner.provenance: Round twenty-three of the MM2 arc, the sixth table-group round (Curtiss Go call on the landed R817 outdoor walk; the pin-time walk found 12 printed grids of 19 die rows each, no defs promoted - the registry stays 809)
banner.sentinel: The pin header stays the print-fidelity record; the grids carry the die, editorial source and special cells, the row rosters ride the audit comments, and the walk cross-checks the registry keys live

audit_comment: THE MM2 AQUATIC ENCOUNTER TABLES WALK - the 12 surface and depths grids (print p. 137 - the gap box label says pp. 150+ but the true folio is 137, the printed page numbers in both scans; the 6 main areas cold, temperate and tropical, each freshwater and saltwater, each surface and depths), every die row 2-20 pinned as the three-cell grid (die, source, special). THE SCHEMA: like the outdoor grids the aquatic grids print no source and no number-encountered columns, so the source cells are EDITORIAL - 1 MM1 / 2 MM2 / 3 FF / 0 none - derived from the print own index and the registry provenance (the lua headers); the special cells 0 the monster rows, 4 the hazard row, 5 the pointer row. THE SETTLED READS (the print index, the registry provenance and the 1eonline roster, three voices collated): the Quipper, Kelpie, Dragonfish, Throat Leech, Vodyanoi, Thork (the Copper Stork, the Boiler Bird parenthetical), the four Urchins (Green, Red, Black, Silver), Crabman, Algoid and Bunyip cells all Fiend Folio per the index F-refs - the registry carries no FF defs, the rows ride keyless. THE EDITORIAL PICKS (all flagged here, the or-row first-creature convention the R816 rule): the Mottled Worm cell the MM1 purple worm parenthetical; the Kopoacinth cell the MM1 water gargoyle parenthetical; the Lacedon cells the MM1 ghoul entry; the Elf, Aquatic cell the MM1 elf entry marine race; the Man, Pirate cell the buccaneer; the Seawolf, Giant cell the greater seawolf (the print cell reads Giant, the entry Greater - flagged); the Snapper, Giant cell the giant snapping turtle; the Eel, Weed cell the MM2 weed entry; the Ixitachitl cells the ixitxachitl spelling; the Sphinx, Andro- cell the hyphen truncation androsphinx; the Scrag cells split freshwater grids vs saltwater grids (the two registry scrags); the Dragonfish or Scrag row rides keyless (the FF first creature). THE FLAGGED CELLS: the Dragon, Sea and Dragon, Spirit cells (3 total) are the oriental lung wang and shan lung cross-refs - no registry def, the OA promotion seam owns them. THE HAZARD ROWS: 13 cells - Ice x2, Whirlpool x3, Island x2, Ghost Ship x3, Seaweed x3 - each cites the p. 137 doctrine codified in the consts above; THE POINTER ROWS: 4 cells - Surface Encounter x3, Land Encounter x1. THE DOCTRINE: the ice hull bands (10-16 ft fresh, 10-60 ft salt, 1-6 damage per round, the 10 percent iceberg hole, the 10-20 ice fields), the ghost ship crew and officer subtables (the 41-60 officer gap pinned verbatim), the sunken ship chart (the 11-20 no-treasure overlap pinned verbatim), the floating seaweed and seaweed bed bands, the island reef bands, the whirlpool arithmetic (75 percent small craft only under 50 ft, 25 percent any vessel, the cumulative rate, 6 rounds to sink) - all pinned as consts and bools and examples.
